avis.titre: A must have for dry skin
avis.texte: This toner feels amazing! At least the skin really soft, radiant supple. Great for under makeup or blending a little drop with your makeup.
I love this toner sooo much! Best milky toner ever!! Goes well with all skin types, beautiful under makeup, and leaves face feeling soo hydrated!

I've been using this for a whole year and I'm happy to say it does improve my skin from dryness and dullness to glowy and more glass skin-like each day 😘 Initially it did break me out, but after few days later it went away and my skin looked better than before.
Out of all the toners I've used, this right here is THE BEST toner ever made! I really see and feel a major difference on my face. I'm definitely repurchasing this after I finish it!
I enjoy using this product before applying my makeup. It is refreshing, my skin feels very cool and soft. The glow it adds on is wonderful.

avis.titre: A must for your skincare routine!
avis.texte: This product is an absolute must for any skincare routine! I tried it about 6 months ago and now can't live without it!

avis.titre: The toner I keep coming back to
avis.texte: You need to hear me out the TIRTIR Milk Skin Toner is one of the best, if not the best, K-beauty products period. If you want long-day hydration, a healthy skin barrier, and the best base under makeup, this is it. I use it as my first step after cleansing while my face is still wet, tap it into my skin, then repeat again after 2 minutes for that Korean glass-skin glow. I love it with the Milk Ampoule, and this is coming from someone who has finished so many bottles I stopped counting.

This product is genuinely so incredible! It does not break me out and it looks stunning underneath makeup! It produces such a seamless and glowy look on the skin and it's soothing!! This product has helped make my skin look brighter and way more hydrated, I'm incredibly happy I got my hands on this toner!!!
I received this as a free sample and started using it in my day and night routines. It made me break out with those itchy pimples that come to a head. I stopped using it and stopped breaking out.

This is a great hydrating toner but it was very sticky. It keeps my skin hydrated and works well as skincare. I tried to use this under makeup and it works well but i just cant get over the sticky feeling

This is great for the face, but let's talk about what it did for my hands. My hands have always been dry especially in the winter. Nothing I apply helps. I've been rubbing the leftover toner on my hands and they are the softest they have ever been.
This ia a great product! I used prescribed retinol, its drys me out. I use this toner to help with the dryness of my skin and it helps alot.

Title says it all and it should be mentioned i could easily have a 24 step routine….doesn't matter, TirTir milk skin toner will always be a part of it. i cant even describe what this does for my skin. it's so much product where so little goes a long way, so affordable, and does everything. Everything. Glow, moisturize, firm, it leaves nothing to be desired. I'll never be without this. I first stole it from my husband who has oily skin and this didn't work for him but i have dry skin and this is my holy grail, if that helps at all.

avis.titre: The best milky toner I've tried
avis.texte: Ive tried virtually every milky toner on the market and this us the best, hands down. Hydrating but light and it makes my pores disappear!
I have sensitive dry skin and Ive used this toner all winter and it's the first time my skin hasn't had dry patches and essentially peeled off in the winter. I would recommend!

I have been using this for a few weeks and this is be best skin care product ive ever used. I tend to think toners are a scam/generally useless but this toner has changed my mind. out of every skin care product ive ever tried, this is hands down my favorite by far. Cannot recommend this enough

I have been using this toner for almost a year now and my skin definitely improved a lot ever since! My skin is sensitive and dry, so this was a bit too much initially because I wasn't prepared for the long lasting drenched-ness on my face, and I did get a pimple or two at first. After using this for 3 weeks my face no longer get pimples from it, more glass skin radiance 😍 This was the only products I used twice daily & amazing result for me!
I have very dry skin, and hyperpigmentation. This toner reduced redness and makes my skin feel very plump and hydrated. Hydration lasts for over 12hrs. Buying a second bottle today!
I've used two other milk toners including the rhode milk toner. This is better in my opinion, feels nice and works well with my makeup. In love with this
It keeps the skin super hydrated all day long. My skin is no longer dry and I can see a difference in my makeup. Highly recommend!
I really wanted to love this but I started noticing immediatley my skin started to get irritated and I got little bumps in my skin. If you have sensitive skin I'd stay away from this.

avis.titre: Best Toner By Far - Please never discontinue
avis.texte: This is by far my favorite skincare product. I was trying many different rice toners but my search ended once I discovered this one. It wish I could lather it over my whole body. And the packaging is plastic free and STUNNING! Criminally underrated!
Absolutely one of my favorite toners currently. I use this after my Acwell toner and end up with the juiciest skin ever. Love love love xx

This is a great milky toner. Very nourishing and soaks into my skin making it feel plump and refreshed. This replaces my other brand (a very popular brand not sold at Ulta). TirTir is a great price and the packaging is a substantial frosted glass bottle. I was influence by m/u artists Nikki LaRose to by this - glad I did!
I love this toner because it is light and refreshing on the skin. It is my nightly go-to product.💖 ✨️
after experimenting with manh other milky tomers, i found this one! it is really amazing and definitely would recommend over anuthing else.. another great contender is the anua milky toner!
My skin craves this toner after I wash my face. It feels so good going on and hydrates without it being heavy.
This toner feels just like a light moisturizer that seriously hydrates all day. Its a little sticky but thats how i know it will stay all day. Summertime fave.
